title: How is Queen Victoria connected to Big Bird?
description:
Four real photos connect Queen Victoria to Big Bird from Sesame Street, through a king who gave up his throne, a president and a first lady.

Queen Victoria → Edward VIII → Richard Nixon → Pat Nixon → Big Bird

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

Photo 2 by Jack Kightlinger, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Nixon_greets_the_Duke_and_Duchess_of_Windsor_-_NARA_-_194310.tif
